title: Kernels, images, generated ideals and quotients of quasi-coherent algebras are quasi-coherent, computed on affine opens
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. A *quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-algebra* is a sheaf of commutative $\mathcal O_X$-algebras whose underlying $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] is quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent]. (a) Let $\psi:\mathcal B\to\mathcal A$ be a morphism of quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-algebras. Then the kernel $\mathcal J=\ker\psi$ ($U\mapsto\ker\psi_U$) is a sheaf of ideals of $\mathcal B$ which is quasi-coherent, the image $\operatorname{Im}\psi\subseteq\mathcal A$ (the subsheaf of local sections of $\mathcal A$ which are locally in the image of $\psi$) is a sub-$\mathcal O_X$-algebra of $\mathcal A$ which is quasi-coherent, and for every affine open $U\subseteq X$: $\mathcal J(U)=\ker(\psi_U)$ and $(\operatorname{Im}\psi)(U)=\psi_U(\mathcal B(U))$. (b) Let $\mathcal B$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-algebra, $\mathcal E$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module and $e:\mathcal E\to\mathcal B$ an $\mathcal O_X$-linear map. Let $(e(\mathcal E))\subseteq\mathcal B$ be the sheaf of ideals generated by $e(\mathcal E)$ (the smallest sheaf of ideals of $\mathcal B$ containing $e_U(\mathcal E(U))$ for all open $U$; it is the image of the $\mathcal O_X$-linear map $\mathcal B\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal E\to\mathcal B$, $b\otimes s\mapsto b\,e(s)$). Then $(e(\mathcal E))$ is quasi-coherent, and for every affine open $U$, $(e(\mathcal E))(U)$ is the ideal of $\mathcal B(U)$ generated by $e_U(\mathcal E(U))$. The quotient $\mathcal B/(e(\mathcal E))$ (sheafification of $U\mapsto\mathcal B(U)/(e(\mathcal E))(U)$) is a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-algebra with a surjective algebra map $q:\mathcal B\to\mathcal B/(e(\mathcal E))$ such that for every affine open $U$ the map $q_U$ is surjective with kernel $(e(\mathcal E))(U)$, i.e. $(\mathcal B/(e(\mathcal E)))(U)=\mathcal B(U)/(e(\mathcal E))(U)$; and for every morphism of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-algebras $\chi:\mathcal B\to\mathcal C$ with $\chi\circ e=0$ there is exactly one algebra map $\bar\chi:\mathcal B/(e(\mathcal E))\to\mathcal C$ with $\bar\chi\circ q=\chi$.
